The ONE channel-bootstrap helper for the omarchy keeper lanes (T11 —
single source; R3: no duplicated channel-set + update + roundtrip blocks
anywhere). Installs /usr/local/bin/channel-bootstrap <channel> which:
1) omarchy-channel-set <channel> (accepting the rc/edge downgrades), 2) the
full package update (pacman -Suu --noconfirm), 3) for dev: the ~/omarchy
source checkout (the dev channel binds the OS to it). Keeper beds call it
exactly once and assert the roundtrip with omarchy-channel-current.
